reviewType: AI source-backed technical provenance and license review
scope: Local dist assets, declarations and direct primary license sources; no publication, outreach, purchase, font download or runtime changes performed.

framework.name: Compliance Auditor — agency-agents
framework.application: Scoped evidence collection, current versus target state, remediation and verification; no SOC2/ISO certification or legal interpretation claimed.

findings.evidence: dist/lucide.min.js header declares lucide v1.8.0 - ISC. dist/lucide-LICENSE.txt includes ISC notice and Feather-derived icon MIT notice. Primary v1.8.0 license corroborates both notices.
findings.action: Keep complete notice with distribution; record version and local checksum. No user choice needed to retain required notices.
findings.limits: Full minified binary was not byte-compared to an official release artifact; copyright grants assessed from identified license, not all code provenance.

findings.evidence: 41 WOFF2 subset files downloaded from official fonts.gstatic.com, total 1082584 bytes; Nunito CDN v32 and Noto Sans JP CDN v57. Exact URLs/SHA256 and matching official family OFL notices recorded in font-provenance.json. Runtime integration of fonts.css is performed by parent agent.
findings.action: Replace Google Fonts link in index.html with local fonts.css, preserve OFL notices, and rerun glyph coverage when course content changes.
findings.limits: CDN version identifiers and binary SHA256 pin exact resources; internal semantic font version not independently extracted. Existing rare component 𠂇 remains rendered as SVG. Browser loaded representative Vietnamese/Japanese glyphs as local custom fonts with external font requests blocked. No overall commercial clearance issued.

findings.evidence: n5-data.js cites JLPT Sensei as the N5 list reference. Current primary terms reserve material rights, permit personal access subject to restrictions, and prohibit republishing/copying/redistribution. The project holds curated local strings; whether any protected source expression or selection was copied is not established by the citation alone.
findings.action: Maintain a provenance record for each locally authored explanation/example. Do not import or reproduce source lessons, examples or illustrations under an assumption that citation grants permission. Resolve imported protected material by permission or independently authored replacement.
findings.limits: No claim of infringement or determination about copyrightability of individual Kanji/basic facts is made. No request for permission has been sent.

findings.evidence: CJKVI README says ids.txt derives from CHISE and follows its terms, distinguishes an extension file, and describes other data as GPLv2. Runtime has local recipes and a reference link; no IDS database file was found in dist.
findings.action: Identify exact source file/revision and any copied or derived data before distributing it; retain applicable notices and satisfy that file's terms. Use as a factual cross-check separately from an explicit data-import pipeline.
findings.limits: Do not label the entire game GPL merely because it links to CJKVI. Exact CHISE file license obligations are not resolved by CJKVI README alone.

findings.evidence: gem-art.js generates gemstone SVGs, cosmos.svg is local vector markup, fusion-fx.js implements effects and n5-game.js synthesizes oscillator audio. No supplied PopCap raster reference files or sampled audio tracks appear in dist. User references explicitly sought visual similarity to PopCap gems.
findings.action: Keep authorship/history evidence; compare final gem silhouettes, faceting, palette, UI identity and sound as a whole. Produce a distinct original art direction before commercial release if provenance or similarity remains uncertain.
findings.limits: Procedural rendering is not proof that a visual design is original. No legal clearance, trademark availability search or infringement finding is issued.

userDecisions.question: Chọn hướng xây bộ nội dung để có thể phát hành thương mại sau này?

options.label: Nội dung biên soạn riêng + nguồn có giấy phép rõ
options.tradeoff: Giữ cơ chế và danh mục sơ cấp; tự viết lời giải thích/ví dụ, ghi nguồn đối chiếu từng mục. Cần thêm công biên tập, tránh phụ thuộc quyền sao chép giáo trình bên ngoài.

options.label: Xin quyền dùng nội dung nguồn
options.tradeoff: Giữ phần thực sự lấy từ nguồn khi có cho phép rõ; có thể phát sinh phí và thời gian chờ. Chưa gửi liên hệ, chỉ chuẩn bị hồ sơ nếu được chọn.

options.label: Dùng bộ dữ liệu được cấp phép và đáp ứng điều kiện
options.tradeoff: Dễ mở rộng hơn nhưng phải chọn bộ cụ thể, kiểm tra attribution/share-alike/GPL theo từng dữ liệu và cách phân phối trước khi nhập.

userDecisions.question: Chọn hướng xử lý bộ đá lấy cảm hứng từ PopCap trước khi thương mại hóa?

options.label: Giữ motif đá quý, tạo phong cách riêng
options.tradeoff: Giữ màu/hình ghép và độ trong trẻo; phát triển facet, viền, ánh sáng, nền và thương hiệu riêng. Cần duyệt mẫu trước khi thay toàn bộ.

options.label: Giữ bản hiện tại để thử local
options.tradeoff: Không mất thời gian đổi art lúc kiểm chứng gameplay; quyền nguồn và mức độ tương đồng vẫn là mục chờ trước phát hành.

options.label: Chọn bộ asset có giấy phép thương mại
options.tradeoff: Có thể tiết kiệm công vẽ nhưng cần tìm bộ hợp chữ Kanji, kiểm tra license và chi phí; không tự mua khi chưa chọn gói cụ thể.

safeNextActions: Retain existing Lucide license notices and record declared v1.8.0.
Pin and self-host approved font families with their matching OFL notices; no font-family replacement is necessary.
Keep source-backed AI review separate from owner provenance confirmation and final commercial clearance.
Record explicit original authorship or licensed origin per new content/art entry.
Exclude unused legacy runtime files from any later release package after dependency checks.
